CXII

Death? let it come when it will, whether it smite but a part or the whole: Fly, you tell me—fly! But whither shall 
I fly? Can any man cast me beyond the limits of the World? It may not be! And whithersoever I go, there shall I still find Sun, Moon, and Stars; there shall I find dreams, and omens, and converse with the Gods!
